name: susar-pancreatitis
input:
Study drug: TX-401 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): nausea, diarrhoea, headache
Narrative: A 58-year-old man was admitted to hospital for 4 days with acute pancreatitis (lipase 9x ULN) on day 21 of dosing. He recovered.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

name: non-serious-headache
input:
Study drug: TX-401 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): nausea, diarrhoea, headache
Narrative: A 34-year-old woman reported a mild headache two hours after dosing. It resolved without treatment the same day.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

name: sponsor-upgrades-causality
input:
Study drug: TX-512 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): rash, fatigue
Narrative: A 61-year-old woman was admitted for 9 days with interstitial lung disease confirmed on CT on day 40 of dosing. She recovered with steroids.
Investigator causality: not related
Sponsor causality: related (reasonable possibility; class effect reported for the target)

name: er-visit-not-admitted
input:
Study drug: TX-512 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): rash, fatigue
Narrative: A 45-year-old man attended the emergency department for 5 hours with palpitations. ECG showed sinus tachycardia; he was discharged home the same day and was not admitted.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

name: elective-admission
input:
Study drug: TX-620 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): dizziness, somnolence
Narrative: A 70-year-old woman was admitted for a total knee replacement that was scheduled before she enrolled. Her pre-existing osteoarthritis had not worsened during the study.
Investigator causality: not related
Sponsor causality: not related

name: fatal-outcome-of-listed-event
input:

Investigator causality: related

name: worst-criterion-wins
input:
Study drug: TX-733 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): headache
Narrative: A 52-year-old woman was admitted after a seizure. On the second day of the admission she had a respiratory arrest and needed intubation and ventilation. She recovered and was discharged on day 9.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

name: hypothetical-not-life-threatening
input:
Study drug: TX-818 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): nausea, injection-site reaction
Narrative: A 49-year-old man was admitted for 2 days with moderate hypoglycaemia (glucose 2.9 mmol/L). He was alert throughout and was never at immediate risk of death. The investigator noted the event 'could have become life-threatening had it not been treated'.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related

name: medically-important-seizure
input:
Study drug: TX-818 (investigational, interventional phase II trial)
RSI expected adverse reactions (Investigator's Brochure): dizziness
Narrative: A 29-year-old woman had a generalised tonic-clonic seizure at home. Paramedics treated her on scene; she was not taken to hospital and recovered fully.
Investigator causality: related
Sponsor causality: related
